# review.jobs

> review.jobs is an AI-powered employee review platform that helps companies build authentic employer brands through eNPS tracking, sentiment analysis, and strategic review management.

review.jobs enables HR professionals and employers to collect, analyze, and leverage employee feedback to strengthen employer branding, improve workplace culture, and drive talent acquisition. The platform combines employee reviews with advanced analytics and eNPS measurement to create data-driven insights for strategic HR decisions.

## Key Topics

- Employee Reviews
- eNPS (Employee Net Promoter Score)
- Employer Branding
- HR Analytics
- AI-Powered Sentiment Analysis
- Workplace Culture
- Employee Engagement
- Reputation Management
- Review Management
- Employee Retention
- Talent Acquisition
- HR Strategy
- ReviewBox Widget
- Data-Driven HR
